title: Hasselblad 500C/M 6x6 Analog Medium Format
purpose: Legendary square-format 120 analog film portraiture with Carl Zeiss Planar optics and organic silver halide grain structure.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Hasselblad 500C/M 6x6 Medium Format SLR Film Camera
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~44mm full-frame equivalent field of view in 1:1 aspect ratio
sensor_and_optics.lens: Carl Zeiss Planar T* 80mm f/2.8 CF Lens
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Kodak Professional Portra 400 fine-grain color negative film stock
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops of analog highlight latitude with gentle shoulder roll-off
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Synchro-Compur mechanical leaf shutter, 1/500s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Soft directional daylight through vintage industrial windows or giant diffused bounce board
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Gentle, non-linear analog tonal curve, soft luminous highlights, deep warm shadow density

surface_rendering: Authentic organic Kodak Portra 400 silver halide dye clouds, fine microscopic grain without digital noise
True tactile skin texture: resolved pores, natural skin micro-creases, fine vellus hair with warm analog tones
Carl Zeiss T* multicoating micro-contrast: rich chromatic saturation without digital chromatic aberration
depth_and_optics: Velvety medium-format square focal falloff unique to 6x6 planar optics
Soft circular bokeh with creamy background dissolution
Pure optical perspective without rectilinear digital warping

execution_directive: Enforce authentic 6x6 medium-format analog film rendering. Kodak Portra 400 color science, Zeiss Planar micro-contrast, organic grain structure, and square aspect composition.
